title: Stage 3.3 Unified OpenRouter Gateway Foundation

transitions.note: Stacked on V202-01 while Vercel preview is externally rate-limited.
Introduce a server-only unified gateway with explicit in-memory credential/funding context. Existing API routes remain on legacy helpers until a separate cutover.

notes: No database read/write, no KMS/decryption, no route cutover, no user credential persistence. Gateway accepts an already-resolved server-side credential context and delegates to OpenRouter transport.
